partnershipPlan: Two parents from the family advisory council review the criteria card; a night nurse and a respiratory therapist join each cycle review; the PICU lead attends monthly.
socialListening: No social media listening; the ward's family feedback cards from the last two winters are read for mentions of oxygen or high flow.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: She looked well for a whole day, but every doctor said something different about when the tubes could come off.
items.implication: Give parents the criteria card at the start of high flow.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At three in the morning with four babies on flow, I am not starting a trial off unless someone tells me to.
items.implication: Measure night adherence and consider a fixed 22:00 assessment.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The tiny ones are the ones who come back to us; I would not stop them cold.
items.implication: Keep stepwise weaning under 8 weeks and review every re-escalation.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We live an hour away; if he got worse we would go to our local hospital, not back to you.
items.implication: Ask about attendance elsewhere in the 7-day call.

summary: Four composite voices on waiting, night delivery, PICU caution and distance.
